Import/export must preserve every authored row-containing table; converter errors must be zero and warnings classified; model, event and report files must be valid. A zero native process exit without those artifacts is not a semantic pass.

The three missions must start at hours 8, 20 and 32, complete successfully at 10, 22 and 34, and return before the 36-hour stop. The one CAL24 PM must start at 24 and complete at 25. A second PM start at 49 or any additional PM task must be absent before the child horizon.

Treat these quantities as hypotheses until native replay.
